cases.title: Record Visited Links to Global History
cases.description: Verify that visited links are successfully recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Verify correct link is recorded after server redirect
cases.description: Verify that the correct link is recorded to the Global History after a server redirect occurs.

cases.title: Launch history link in browser window
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a history link causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Delete a History entry
cases.description: Verify that a History entry can be successfully deleted.

cases.title: Delete Multiple History Entries
cases.description: Verify that selecting and deleting multiple History entries removes them and ensures they are no longer displayed.

cases.title: Clear Global History
cases.description: Verify that executing the clear global history action successfully clears the Global History.

cases.title: Group history items by Day
cases.description: Verify that history items are successfully grouped by Day when the Day grouping option is selected.

cases.title: Group history items by Site
cases.description: Verify that history items are successfully grouped by Site when the Site grouping option is selected.

cases.title: Group history items by None
cases.description: Verify that history items are displayed without any grouping when the None grouping option is selected.

cases.title: Sort History per Column
cases.description: Verify that history is sorted per column.

cases.title: Reverse-Sort History per Column
cases.description: Verify that history is reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns are resizable to show or hide more of entries.

cases.title: Show History columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be shown.

cases.title: Hide History columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be hidden.

cases.title: Re-visit recently visited sites via Back and Forward button dropdown menu
cases.description: Verify that recently visited sites can be re-visited using the Back and Forward button dropdown menu.

cases.title: New Empty Session History File Created for New Browser Window
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is created when a new browser window is opened.

cases.title: New Empty Session History File Created for Restart
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is created when the browser is restarted.

opinions.feedback: The test cases adequately cover the requirements with appropriate granularity for distinct operations such as grouping, sorting, column visibility, and window/restart initialization.
All test cases map correctly to the specified requirements without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: R-073: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Visited links are recorded to the Global History. Trigger: Visiting a link. Outcome: Link is recorded in Global History. R-074: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: The correct link is recorded to the Global History after a server redirect. Trigger: Server redirect occurs on a visited link. Outcome: The correct link is recorded. R-075: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Clicking on a history link launches it in a browser window. Trigger: Clicking a history link. Outcome: Link is launched in a browser window. R-076: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: A History entry is deleted. Trigger: Deletion action on a History entry. Outcome: History entry is deleted. R-077: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Multiple History entries are deleted and no longer displayed. Trigger: Deletion action on multiple History entries. Outcome: Entries are deleted and no longer displayed. R-078: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Global History is cleared. Trigger: Clear global history action. Outcome: Global History is cleared. R-079: Multiple distinct behaviors. Normal scenarios warranted. Atomic behaviors: History items grouped by Day, History items grouped by Site, History items grouped by None. Trigger: Selecting Day, Site, or None grouping option. Outcome: History items are grouped accordingly. R-080: Multiple distinct behaviors. Normal scenarios warranted. Atomic behaviors: History sorted per column, History reverse-sorted per column. Trigger: Sorting or reverse-sorting a column. Outcome: History is ordered per the column and direction. R-081: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: History columns are resizable to show or hide more of entries. Trigger: Resizing a history column. Outcome: Column dimensions change to show/hide more of entries. R-082: Multiple distinct behaviors. Normal scenarios warranted. Atomic behaviors: History columns shown, History columns hidden. Trigger: Action to show or hide history columns. Outcome: Columns are shown or hidden. R-083: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Recently visited sites are re-visited via Back and Forward button dropdown menu. Trigger: Selecting a site from Back or Forward button dropdown menu. Outcome: Site is re-visited. R-084: Multiple distinct behaviors. Normal scenarios warranted. Atomic behaviors: New empty session history file created for a new browser window, New empty session history file created for a restart. Trigger: Opening a new browser window or restarting. Outcome: A new, empty session history file is created.
